Container.Name: maniac-media
Container.Overview: Maniac Media – unified movie and TV automation (Sonarr + Radarr in one). Metadata, indexers, download clients, automatic import, renaming, quality profiles, users and an encrypted, migratable database.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, encrypted secrets, logs, backups and plugins

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Share containing media/ and downloads/. Keep both on ONE share so imports can hardlink. Map your download client to /data the same way.

Config.Name: Master key
Config.Description: Encrypts stored credentials. Generate once with: openssl rand -base64 32 – and keep a copy somewhere safe.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as (100 = users)

Config.Name: Movies folder (first run)
Config.Description: Initial movie root folder – change later in Settings

Config.Name: TV folder (first run)
Config.Description: Initial TV root folder – change later in Settings

Config.Name: Downloads folder (first run)
Config.Description: Initial download watch folder – change later in Settings
